methods.summary: Upload a root CA certificate to the Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone.
methods.description:
Upload a root CA certificate to the Custom Origin Trust Store for a Zone. Only
root CA certificates are accepted.

props.name: certificate
props.description:
The root CA certificate in PEM format. Only root CA certificates are
accepted; intermediate and leaf certificates are not supported.
